points.point: Natural (1,2,3…) → Whole (+0) → Integers (+negatives) → next: Rational Numbers.
−3/4 = neither integer nor (ordinary) fraction ⇒ need to extend number system to rationals.
Rational ⇔ p/q with integers p, q and q ≠ 0; includes negatives like −3/4 and decimals like 0.5.

points.concept: अंश, हर और समतुल्य परिमेय संख्याएँ
points.point: Integers ⊂ Rationals; equivalent rationals by ×/÷ same nonzero integer on p and q.
Positive if p,q same sign; negative if opposite; 0 is neither positive nor negative rational.
Mark |p/q| on the correct side of 0; negatives are left-side mirrors of positives.
Standard form: positive denominator, HCF(p,q)=1; if denominator negative, divide by −HCF.
On number line, right is greater; for two negatives, flip the inequality after comparing without signs.
